name: Deep Wilderness Dungeon
accessNote: Wilderness hill giants for Krystilia: the Deep Wilderness Dungeon holds 6 spawns (~level 50 Wilderness), with further F2P Wilderness spawns at the Boneyard Hunter area and the Lava Maze. Kills count for Krystilia only in the Wilderness. Multicombat, cannon, and safespot status are not stated on the fetched wiki pages and are left conservatively false (honest-UNKNOWN); beware player killers.
